load_stanford_lightfield_data: load Stanford light field dataset images, poses, and camera intrinsics from a basedir with optional downsampling
load_data_without_images: load only camera poses and depth bounds from a Stanford light field dataset without loading images
generate_spiral_render_poses: generate spiral render poses and intrinsics for novel view synthesis from loaded Stanford light field data
generate_lightfield_render_poses: generate lightfield render poses along a specified display row for novel view synthesis from Stanford data
review_load_stanford_data: review the load_stanford_data function to understand how it loads, rescales, and repositions Stanford light field data
